::: {#fig-composition}

```{r}
#| label: composition-alt
#| include: false
fig_alt <- paste(
  "Two parabolas over x from -3 to 3.",
  "The curve for f of g of x has its lowest point, 0, at x = -1.",
  "The curve for g of f of x has its lowest point, 1, at x = 0.",
  "The two curves cross at x = 0, where both equal 1.",
  "At x = 2 the first curve is at 9 and the second is at 5,",
  "and both points are marked."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: composition-plot
#| fig-alt: !expr fig_alt
x_grid <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 241)
fg_label <- "f(g(x)) = (x + 1)^2"
gf_label <- "g(f(x)) = x^2 + 1"
compositions <- data.frame(
  x = rep(x_grid, 2),
  composition = rep(c(fg_label, gf_label), each = length(x_grid)),
  value = c((x_grid + 1)^2, x_grid^2 + 1)
)
at_two <- data.frame(
  x = 2,
  composition = c(fg_label, gf_label),
  value = c(9, 5)
)

composition_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = compositions,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = value, colour = composition)
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = at_two,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = value, colour = composition),
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = at_two,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = value, label = value),
    nudge_x = -0.3,
    nudge_y = 0.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00")) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Input, x", y = "Output, value", colour = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  htmltools::div(
    role = "img",
    `aria-label` = fig_alt,
    plotly::ggplotly(composition_plot) |>
      plotly::layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
  )
} else {
  composition_plot
}
```

The [compositions](#def-composition) $f \circ g$ and $g \circ f$ of @exm-composition are different [functions](#def-function).
At $x = 2$ they take the [values](#def-value) $9$ and $5$.

:::
